mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, content_type, is_read,create_time) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{isRead},#{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}) OR (sender_id = #{receiverId} AND receiver_id = #{senderId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
